shared_elements: upright rectangular stone pillar/slab as the carved support
shallow low-relief carving cut into weathered pale stone
animal head/creature rendered in profile projecting from the surface
curved, arm- or limb-like relief band
surrounding excavated rubble and stone walling at the base
justification: Both are tall rectangular stone monoliths standing in a rubble-filled trench, each bearing shallow carving that includes a curved limb-like relief and an animal head in profile, which gives a broadly similar first impression. The decisive differences are density and technique: A carries a crowded multi-register programme of quadrupeds, patterned bands, birds and a human-like figure in crisp flat relief, whereas B is almost bare apart from one sweeping relief arm and a fully three-dimensional projecting head on badly eroded stone.
